## Who the analysis helps

::: {.section-lede}
Even without meeting patients directly, helping the people who prescribe, dispense, make, and supply medicines can contribute to people's health.
:::

```{=html}
<div class="audience">
  <div><h3>Doctors</h3><p>See reimbursement and supply changes for an ingredient before prescribing.</p></div>
  <div><h3>Pharmacists</h3><p>Know about announced price cuts and suspensions early and plan stock.</p></div>
  <div><h3>Drug makers</h3><p>Follow the market for their ingredients and competitors' price changes in one view.</p></div>
  <div><h3>Distributors</h3><p>Use ingredient demand trends as a baseline for supply planning and pharmacy alerts.</p></div>
</div>
```
:::

::: {.home-section}
## How I work

::: {.principle}
Find the action with the least resistance that can still be carried out within the constraints.
:::

If there is no evidence that a complex method beats a simple one, I choose the simple one. I fix decision rules before seeing results, and I report unfavorable results as they are.
:::

::: {.home-section}
